r1.why: Protons in every nucleus [4], atomic number Z [6], electrostatic binding of electrons [5], determine chemistry [7], hydrogen lone proton [23], deuterium/tritium one and two neutrons [24].

r6.why: Accelerators for proton therapy and physics experiments, LHC most powerful [17]; free protons bind electrons at low temperature and energy [16].
